units: pixels (full 1080x1920 resolution), seconds; y grows downward

camera.method: phase correlation of rows 0-1000 between frame 0 and frame 74 (response 0.99)
camera.perspective: road recedes to a vanishing area near (530, 1400); the creature walks across the road at constant depth (hoof line y ~1547 every frame, height 413-428 px), so its motion is a fronto-parallel, purely horizontal translation in the image (2D scene).

creature.description: the single animal: a horse-like unicorn/kirin (tan/grey body, pale blue-white chest and face, long curled grey mane-crest sweeping back over the neck, long thin tail, small horn/ears); faces and walks to the RIGHT (+x) across the road, walking gait
creature.occluded: never; fully inside frame at all frames (nose x max 1042 < 1080)
creature.reference_point: ref_x = chest_front_x - 129.0 px (chest-front edge of the trunk, shifted to the mask centroid; the smoothest horizontal proxy of the body origin), ref_y = mask centroid y

road.note: asphalt road running away from camera, vanishing near (530, 1400); widens to full image width at bottom

yellow_line_left.note: curved yellow marking left of centre

left_bushes.note: yellow-green shrubs, left roadside, BEHIND the creature

right_bushes.note: shrubs right roadside, behind the creature

events.event: clip starts with creature already walking right (no start of motion seen)
clip ends, creature still walking right (no stop seen)

events.note: no bounce/impact/contact with other objects; no direction change; walking gait throughout

files.bg_plate_small.jpg: half-res clean background plate (full-res plate is regenerated by scripts/background.py into frames/) (frame 0 with creature filled from frame 74)
